_comment: Non-secret test data for the designed OpenEMR portal suite, taken from requirements/openemr-patient-portal-prd.md sections 26-27 (observed on the demo 2026-09-15). Credentials are NOT here: scripts/test_data.py provision adds patient1_*/patient2_* (secrets, else the public demo login) and random invalid_* values. Names are a first guess, provisioned before design so kane-cli reuses them instead of inventing new ones; reconcile against the first real design run's *_test.md files and the stubs it reports.

invalid_login_error.value: Something went wrong. Please try again.

baseline_pending_comment._note: Comment typed into 'Comments about change request' on Edit Profile. Pooled so kane-cli design reuses it: run 1's uc-3 design failed referencing this name undeclared.

clinical_document_edit_field_label._note: Free-text, optional field in the 'Other' group of the History (HIS) form that the Medical History template embeds ({EncounterForm:HIS}); from OpenEMR sql/database.sql, not yet seen on the live demo.

patient2_appointment_marker._note: Susan's provider on her appointment rows (PRD §27); Phil's are with Billy Smith.

unavailable_appointment_time._note: Outside clinic hours, so absent from any provider's See Availability slots.

other_patient_pid._note: Susan Underwood's pid (Clinical Documents link on her dashboard: onsitedocuments?pid=2); patient 1 (Phil) is pid 1.
